header.title: Our Journey
header.subtitle: Tracing the key milestones in our growth and innovation

timeline.name: ISO 9001:2015 Certification
timeline.description: As a commitment to improving product quality and management, PT. Esa Bumindo successfully obtained ISO 9001:2015 certification. This achievement confirms the company's readiness to compete at national and international levels through excellent quality management standards.

timeline.name: Second Factory Expansion
timeline.description: Established a second factory in the Mekar Jaya Industrial Area, Tangerang Regency, to expand production capacity and meet the growing market demand.

timeline.name: First Factory Construction
timeline.description: Successfully built the first factory located in Kampung Gruduk, Tangerang Regency, Banten, as a strategic step to increase production capacity.

timeline.name: Beginning of Independent Production
timeline.description: Started independent production activities by renting factory facilities in the Tangerang area as the first operational location.

timeline.name: Company Establishment
timeline.description: PT. Esa Bumindo was officially established as a company engaged in production and industrial development.
